ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 38
   C. 88
   D. 22

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 2/2
   D. 1/4

3. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 100
   C. 10
   D. 11

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 46
   B. 23
   C. 120
   D. 30

5. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

6. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

7. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

8. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

11. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

12. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 40.5
   C. 9
   D. 10

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 75
   C. 20
   D. 30

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 55
   B. 16
   C. 22
   D. 32

15. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23.7
   D. 23

16. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

17. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 1

18. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

19. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.7
   C. 33
   D. 27.6

20. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 8
   C. 32
   D. 9

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 34
   C. 17
   D. 22

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 90
   C. 21
   D. 30

23. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 18
   D. 9

24. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
